description: Build a favicon pack from an image or up to three letters. The ZIP contains favicon.ico, PNG sizes, a web manifest, an HTML snippet, and a Next.js metadata snippet. Letters are drawn with a built-in bitmap font so the result does not depend on a system font. Send base64 or a public URL. Private addresses are refused and the decoded file is capped at 10 MB.

file.description: A square-or-any image. Provide file or text.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

text.description: Up to three letters drawn as the mark. Provide file or text.

name: generate_favicon

data.description: ZIP of the favicon files as base64.

title: Generate a favicon pack
